statement: The US Department of Defense or the White House publicly confirms US military strikes on targets inside Iran between 2026-08-08 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from defense.gov news releases and whitehouse.gov briefing transcripts on 2026-10-30. Yes if any on-record item published in the window confirms US strikes on Iranian territory.

statement: At least one additional commercial vessel is struck by weapons in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-08-08 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the UKMTO maritime incident report index on 2026-09-30. Yes if any advisory in the window records a commercial vessel struck by missile, drone or gunfire in those waters.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude settles above 110.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the official ICE Brent front-month settlement series read on 2026-10-30. Yes if any settlement in the window is above 110.00.

statement: NYMEX WTI front-month crude settles above 95.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CME official NYMEX WTI front-month settlement series read on 2026-09-30. Yes if any settlement in the window is above 95.00.

statement: An extraordinary European Council or Justice and Home Affairs Council session on the Ceuta migration crisis convenes between 2026-08-08 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the Council of the EU meeting calendar on 2026-09-30. Yes if a special or extraordinary session in the window lists Ceuta or Spain-Morocco migration on its published agenda.

statement: Gianni Infantino ceases to be FIFA president, by resignation or removal, announced between 2026-08-08 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: Resolved from FIFA official media releases on 2026-12-18. Yes if a release in the window announces his resignation, removal, or replacement as president.

statement: CISA adds an Adobe Campaign Classic vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-08-08 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CISA KEV catalog JSON on 2026-10-30. Yes if any entry has vendorProject Adobe, product matching Campaign Classic, and dateAdded inside the window.

statement: CISA publishes an advisory or alert confirming a cyber incident that disrupted operations at a named US water or wastewater utility, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CISA cybersecurity advisories index on 2026-11-30. Yes if any item published in the window names a US water or wastewater utility with disrupted operations.

statement: INGV records an earthquake of magnitude 4.0 or greater within 30 km of Naples between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved from the INGV ISIDe event query, radius 30 km on 40.85N 14.27E, minmagnitude 4.0, starttime 2026-08-08, endtime 2026-11-30. Yes if any event returns.

statement: Spanish or Moroccan authorities announce criminal charges against ten or more people over the Ceuta mass border crossing between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved from Fiscalia General del Estado, Spanish Interior Ministry, and Moroccan MAP official releases on 2026-11-30. Yes if any names charges against ten or more individuals.
